name: Wet surfaces and puddles
body: Dean (2026-11-17): more renderer work, shaders and materials. A material gets a wetness: wet surfaces darken, turn glossy and mirror the sky and the street lamps, and wet ground facing up breaks into puddles that are almost perfect mirrors. This is the biggest look change available at night for the cost of a few ALU ops and a noise lookup. No screen-space reflections yet (a puddle mirrors the procedural sky and the lights' highlights, not the buildings).
